# Weighted

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Weighted average power plots by beta and k
## Two weighting ways:
##   1) cluster_abund_sum_template
##   2) cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance
##
## Visualization revisions:
##   - smooth each line
##   - keep raw dots
##   - constrain smooth curves to [0, 1]
##   - once power hits 1, keep smooth curve at 1 afterward
##   - box around each subfigure
##   - publication-ready legend labels
##   - no title / subtitle
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## Keep k <= 8
results <- results %>%
  filter(k <= 8)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define colors ONLY for methods you want to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_colors <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean" = "#AB2428",
  "aitchison"                 = "#2F74B8",
  "aitchison_pc1"                 = "#5A97D0",
  "aitchison_pc0.1"                 = "#79B0D7",
  "aitchison_pc0.01"                 = "#A0C8E8",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01" = "#36663E",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1" = "#507D39",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5" = "#8CB26C",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1" = "#AAC576",
  "bray"                      = "#FF8F00",
  "euclidean"                 = "#FFCA28",
  "jaccard"                   = "#FFE082"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Publication-ready method labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean" = "AHC",
  "aitchison_pc0.01"                 = "Aitchison(0.01)",
  "aitchison_pc0.1"                 = "Aitchison(0.1)",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison(0.5)",
  "aitchison_pc1"                 = "Aitchison(1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01" = "ILR Euclidean(0.01)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1" = "ILR Euclidean(0.1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5" = "ILR Euclidean(0.5)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1" = "ILR Euclidean(1)",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Weighting options to plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------
weight_options <- c(
  "abund_sum",
  "abund_sum_x_mean_abund"
)

weight_labels <- c(
  "abund_sum" = "Weighted by cluster abundance sum",
  "abund_sum_x_mean_abund" = "Weighted by abundance sum × mean relative abundance"
)

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)

## -------------------- output folder --------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## -------------------- create long-format result --------------------
select_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

if (has_signal_mode) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "signal_mode")
}

long_res_base <- results %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    beta > 0,
    method %in% names(method_colors)
  )

## =========================================================
## Smoothing helper
##
## Rules:
##   1) smooth within each line
##   2) clamp to [0, 1]
##   3) if raw or smoothed power reaches 1,
##      all later smooth values are set to 1
## =========================================================

smooth_one_curve <- function(dat, y_col = "weighted_power",
                             n_grid = 200, span = 0.75,
                             hit1_tol = 1e-8) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(beta), !is.na(.data[[y_col]])) %>%
    arrange(beta)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(beta = numeric(0), power_smooth = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  x <- dat$beta
  y <- dat[[y_col]]
  
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  
  if (length(ux) == 1) {
    out <- data.frame(
      beta = ux,
      power_smooth = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    out$power_smooth <- pmin(pmax(out$power_smooth, 0), 1)
    
    if (any(y >= 1 - hit1_tol, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      out$power_smooth <- 1
    }
    
    return(out)
  }
  
  grid_x <- seq(
    min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n_grid
  )
  
  pred_y <- NULL
  
  ## Try LOESS when enough beta points are available
  if (length(ux) >= 4 && length(unique(y)) >= 2) {
    
    fit <- try(
      loess(
        formula = as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ beta")),
        data = dat,
        span = span,
        degree = 2,
        family = "gaussian",
        control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
      pred_try <- try(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(beta = grid_x)),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(pred_try, "try-error") && !all(is.na(pred_try))) {
        pred_y <- pred_try
      }
    }
  }
  
  ## Fallback: linear interpolation
  if (is.null(pred_y)) {
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xout = grid_x,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## Fill occasional NA predictions
  if (any(is.na(pred_y))) {
    good <- !is.na(pred_y)
    
    if (sum(good) >= 2) {
      pred_y <- approx(
        x = grid_x[good],
        y = pred_y[good],
        xout = grid_x,
        rule = 2
      )$y
    } else {
      pred_y[is.na(pred_y)] <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  ## Clamp to [0, 1]
  pred_y <- pmin(pmax(pred_y, 0), 1)
  
  ## Once raw power reaches 1, keep all later smoothed values at 1
  raw_hit_beta <- suppressWarnings(min(x[y >= 1 - hit1_tol], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ## Also check whether the smoothed curve itself reaches 1
  smooth_hit_beta <- suppressWarnings(min(grid_x[pred_y >= 1 - hit1_tol], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  hit_beta <- min(raw_hit_beta, smooth_hit_beta, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.finite(hit_beta)) {
    pred_y[grid_x >= hit_beta] <- 1
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    beta = grid_x,
    power_smooth = pred_y
  )
  
  return(out)
}

## =========================================================
## Main function for one weighting option
## =========================================================

make_weighted_power_plot <- function(weight_option) {
  
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Processing weighting option:", weight_option, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n\n")
  
  long_res <- long_res_base %>%
    mutate(
      weight = case_when(
        weight_option == "abund_sum" ~
          cluster_abund_sum_template,
        weight_option == "abund_sum_x_mean_abund" ~
          cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
  
  if (any(is.na(long_res$weight))) {
    stop("Some weights are NA for weight_option = ", weight_option)
  }
  
  if (any(long_res$weight < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop("Some weights are negative for weight_option = ", weight_option)
  }
  
  ## -------------------- weighted average power --------------------
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    
    weighted_power <- long_res %>%
      filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject), !is.na(weight), weight > 0) %>%
      group_by(k, signal_mode, beta, method) %>%
      summarise(
        weighted_power = weighted.mean(reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
        total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(k, signal_mode, beta, method)
    
  } else {
    
    weighted_power <- long_res %>%
      filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject), !is.na(weight), weight > 0) %>%
      group_by(k, beta, method) %>%
      summarise(
        weighted_power = weighted.mean(reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
        total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(k, beta, method)
  }
  
  weighted_power <- weighted_power %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
      weighted_power = pmin(pmax(weighted_power, 0), 1)
    )
  
  ## -------------------- save unsmoothed table --------------------
  write.csv(
    weighted_power,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("Weighted power table saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, ".csv")), "\n\n")
  
  print(as.data.frame(weighted_power), row.names = FALSE)
  
  ## -------------------- smooth --------------------
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    
    smooth_power <- weighted_power %>%
      group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
      group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(
        dat = .x,
        y_col = "weighted_power",
        n_grid = 200,
        span = 0.75
      )) %>%
      ungroup()
    
  } else {
    
    smooth_power <- weighted_power %>%
      group_by(k, method) %>%
      group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(
        dat = .x,
        y_col = "weighted_power",
        n_grid = 200,
        span = 0.75
      )) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  
  smooth_power <- smooth_power %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
      power_smooth = pmin(pmax(power_smooth, 0), 1)
    )
  
  ## -------------------- save smoothed table --------------------
  write.csv(
    smooth_power,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, "_smoothed.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("\nSmoothed weighted power table saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, "_smoothed.csv")), "\n\n")
  
  present_methods <- names(method_colors)[
    names(method_colors) %in% as.character(unique(weighted_power$method))
  ]
  
  ## -------------------- plot --------------------
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = smooth_power,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = power_smooth,
        color = method,
        group = method
      ),
      linewidth = 0.75,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = weighted_power,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = weighted_power,
        color = method,
        group = method
      ),
      size = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = method_colors[present_methods],
      breaks = present_methods,
      labels = method_labels[present_methods],
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(beta),
      y = "Weighted average power",
      color = NULL
    )
  
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    p <- p +
      facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k, labeller = label_both)
  } else {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(~ k, labeller = label_both)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      ## box around each subfigure
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.42, "cm"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(0.9, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        ncol = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(
          linewidth = 1.2,
          size = 1.8,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ## -------------------- save plot --------------------
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 8
  )
  
  cat("\nSmoothed plot saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.png")), "\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.pdf")), "\n")
  
  invisible(list(
    weighted_power = weighted_power,
    smooth_power = smooth_power,
    plot = p
  ))
}

## =========================================================
## Run both weighting figures
## =========================================================

plot_results <- list()

for (w in weight_options) {
  plot_results[[w]] <- make_weighted_power_plot(w)
}

cat("\nAll weighted power plots saved to:\n")
cat(outdir, "\n")
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Smoothed power plot using the largest cluster only
##
## Updates:
## 1) each facet has a border box
## 2) smoothed values are constrained to [0, 1]
## 3) once the smoothed curve hits 1, it stays at 1 afterwards
## 4) raw points are kept
## 5) no title / subtitle
## 6) publication-ready legend labels
##
## Output folder:
##   weighted_power_output
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define colors ONLY for methods you want to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included
##
## Order here = legend order
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_colors <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean" = "#AB2428",
  "aitchison"                 = "#2F74B8",
  "aitchison_pc1"                 = "#5A97D0",
  "aitchison_pc0.1"                 = "#79B0D7",
  "aitchison_pc0.01"                 = "#A0C8E8",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01" = "#36663E",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1" = "#507D39",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5" = "#8CB26C",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1" = "#AAC576",
  "bray"                      = "#FF8F00",
  "euclidean"                 = "#FFCA28",
  "jaccard"                   = "#FFE082"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Publication-ready method labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean" = "AHC",
  "aitchison_pc0.01"                 = "Aitchison(0.01)",
  "aitchison_pc0.1"                 = "Aitchison(0.1)",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison(0.5)",
  "aitchison_pc1"                 = "Aitchison(1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01" = "ILR Euclidean(0.01)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1" = "ILR Euclidean(0.1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5" = "ILR Euclidean(0.5)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1" = "ILR Euclidean(1)",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)
has_cluster_ordered <- "cluster_ordered" %in% names(results)

## -------------------- output folder --------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## -------------------- define situation columns --------------------
situation_cols <- c("k", "beta")
if (has_signal_mode) {
  situation_cols <- c("k", "signal_mode", "beta")
}

## -------------------- choose max-n-OTU cluster under each situation --------------------
cluster_select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  cluster_select_cols <- c(cluster_select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

cluster_choice <- results %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_select_cols)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  {
    if (has_cluster_ordered) {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        cluster_ordered,
        signal_cluster
      )
    } else {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        signal_cluster
      )
    }
  } %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols))) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

cat("Selected largest cluster under each situation:\n")
print(as.data.frame(cluster_choice), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  cluster_choice,
  file = file.path(outdir, "selected_max_n_otu_cluster_by_situation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## -------------------- keep only selected clusters --------------------
selected_results <- results %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  inner_join(
    cluster_choice %>%
      select(all_of(situation_cols), signal_cluster),
    by = c(situation_cols, "signal_cluster")
  )

## -------------------- long-format p-values --------------------
select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

long_res <- selected_results %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% names(method_colors))

## -------------------- compute power for selected cluster only --------------------
if (has_signal_mode) {
  
  max_n_otu_power <- long_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject)) %>%
    group_by(
      k, signal_mode, beta,
      signal_cluster, cluster_n_otus_template,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      power = mean(reject, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(k, signal_mode, beta, method)
  
} else {
  
  max_n_otu_power <- long_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject)) %>%
    group_by(
      k, beta,
      signal_cluster, cluster_n_otus_template,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      power = mean(reject, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(k, beta, method)
}

max_n_otu_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
  )

## -------------------- save unsmoothed power table --------------------
write.csv(
  max_n_otu_power,
  file = file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nPower table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power.csv"), "\n\n")

print(as.data.frame(max_n_otu_power), row.names = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## Smoothing helper
##
## Rules:
## 1) smooth within each line
## 2) clamp to [0, 1]
## 3) once the smoothed curve hits 1, keep all later values at 1
## =========================================================

smooth_one_curve <- function(dat, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75, hit1_tol = 1e-8) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(beta), !is.na(power)) %>%
    arrange(beta)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(beta = numeric(0), power_smooth = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  x <- dat$beta
  y <- dat$power
  
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  
  ## only one unique beta
  if (length(ux) == 1) {
    out <- data.frame(
      beta = ux,
      power_smooth = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    out$power_smooth <- pmin(pmax(out$power_smooth, 0), 1)
    
    hit_idx <- which(out$power_smooth >= 1 - hit1_tol)
    if (length(hit_idx) > 0) {
      out$power_smooth[min(hit_idx):nrow(out)] <- 1
    }
    return(out)
  }
  
  grid_x <- seq(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n_grid)
  
  pred_y <- NULL
  
  ## try loess first if enough support
  if (length(ux) >= 4 && length(unique(y)) >= 2) {
    fit <- try(
      loess(
        power ~ beta,
        data = dat,
        span = span,
        degree = 2,
        family = "gaussian",
        control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
      pred_try <- try(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(beta = grid_x)),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(pred_try, "try-error") && !all(is.na(pred_try))) {
        pred_y <- pred_try
      }
    }
  }
  
  ## fallback: linear interpolation
  if (is.null(pred_y)) {
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xout = grid_x,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## fill NA if needed
  if (any(is.na(pred_y))) {
    good <- !is.na(pred_y)
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = grid_x[good],
      y = pred_y[good],
      xout = grid_x,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## clamp to [0, 1]
  pred_y <- pmin(pmax(pred_y, 0), 1)
  
  ## once hit 1, remain at 1
  hit_idx <- which(pred_y >= 1 - hit1_tol)
  if (length(hit_idx) > 0) {
    pred_y[min(hit_idx):length(pred_y)] <- 1
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    beta = grid_x,
    power_smooth = pred_y
  )
  
  return(out)
}

## -------------------- apply smoothing --------------------
if (has_signal_mode) {
  
  smooth_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
    group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
    group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(.x, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
} else {
  
  smooth_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
    group_by(k, method) %>%
    group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(.x, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

smooth_power <- smooth_power %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
    power_smooth = pmin(pmax(power_smooth, 0), 1)
  )

## -------------------- save smoothed table --------------------
write.csv(
  smooth_power,
  file = file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power_smoothed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSmoothed power table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power_smoothed.csv"), "\n\n")

## -------------------- methods actually present --------------------
present_methods <- names(method_colors)[names(method_colors) %in% as.character(unique(max_n_otu_power$method))]

## =========================================================
## Plot
## =========================================================

p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = smooth_power,
    aes(
      x = beta,
      y = power_smooth,
      color = method,
      group = method
    ),
    linewidth = 0.95,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = max_n_otu_power,
    aes(
      x = beta,
      y = power,
      color = method,
      group = method
    ),
    size = 0.80,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = method_colors[present_methods],
    breaks = present_methods,
    labels = method_labels[present_methods],
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(beta),
    y = "Power",
    color = NULL
  )

if (has_signal_mode) {
  p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- p_max_n_otu_power_smooth +
    facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k, labeller = label_both)
} else {
  p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- p_max_n_otu_power_smooth +
    facet_wrap(~ k, labeller = label_both)
}

p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- p_max_n_otu_power_smooth +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    ## facet boxes / subfigure boxes
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),

    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),

  ) +
  guides(

      ncol = 1,

        linewidth = 1.2,

      )

  )

print(p_max_n_otu_power_smooth)

## -------------------- save plot --------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power_lineplot_smooth.png"),

)
```

# Type1

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Type I error table under each situation
##
## Three ways:
## 1) abund_sum:
##      weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template
##
## 2) abund_sum_x_mean_abund:
##      weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template *
##                  cluster_mean_relative_abundance
##
## 3) max_n_otu_cluster:
##      select the cluster with maximum cluster_n_otus_template
##      under each null situation
##
## Output:
##   1) long-format table
##   2) wide-format table with methods as columns
##   3) one CSV per way
##
## Saved under:
##   weighted_power_output
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Methods to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded.
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included.
##
## Order here = table order
## ---------------------------------------------------------


method_order <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean",
  "aitchison",
  "aitchison_pc1",
  "aitchison_pc0.1",
  "aitchison_pc0.01",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1",
  "bray",
  "euclidean",
  "jaccard"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "AHC_euclidean" = "AHC",
  "aitchison_pc0.01"                 = "Aitchison(0.01)",
  "aitchison_pc0.1"                 = "Aitchison(0.1)",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison(0.5)",
  "aitchison_pc1"                 = "Aitchison(1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.01" = "ILR Euclidean(0.01)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.1" = "ILR Euclidean(0.1)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc0.5" = "ILR Euclidean(0.5)",
  "ILR_euclidean_pc1" = "ILR Euclidean(1)",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)
## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Checks
## ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
    "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)
has_cluster_ordered <- "cluster_ordered" %in% names(results)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Output folder
## ---------------------------------------------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define situation columns
## For type I error, beta is fixed at 0, so situation does not include beta.
## ---------------------------------------------------------
situation_cols <- "k"

if (has_signal_mode) {
  situation_cols <- c("k", "signal_mode")
}

## =========================================================
## 1. Long null data: beta == 0
## =========================================================

select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "beta",
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

null_long <- results %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    false_reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% method_order)

if (nrow(null_long) == 0) {
  stop("No beta == 0 rows found after filtering. Cannot compute type I error.")
}

## =========================================================
## 2. Way 1: weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template
## =========================================================

type1_abund_sum <- null_long %>%
  mutate(
    way = "abund_sum",
    weight = cluster_abund_sum_template
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject),
    !is.na(weight),
    weight > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols)), method, way) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = weighted.mean(false_reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 3. Way 2: weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template * mean abundance
## =========================================================

type1_abund_sum_x_mean_abund <- null_long %>%
  mutate(
    way = "abund_sum_x_mean_abund",
    weight = cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject),
    !is.na(weight),
    weight > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols)), method, way) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = weighted.mean(false_reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 4. Way 3: select max cluster_n_otus_template under each null situation
## =========================================================

cluster_select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  cluster_select_cols <- c(cluster_select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

max_cluster_choice_type1 <- results %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_select_cols)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  {
    if (has_cluster_ordered) {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        cluster_ordered,
        signal_cluster
      )
    } else {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        signal_cluster
      )
    }
  } %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols))) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Selected max-n-OTU cluster under each null situation:\n")
print(as.data.frame(max_cluster_choice_type1), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  max_cluster_choice_type1,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_selected_max_n_otu_cluster_by_situation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

null_long_max_cluster <- null_long %>%
  inner_join(
    max_cluster_choice_type1 %>%
      select(all_of(situation_cols), signal_cluster),
    by = c(situation_cols, "signal_cluster")
  )

type1_max_n_otu_cluster <- null_long_max_cluster %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    way = "max_n_otu_cluster"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    across(all_of(situation_cols)),
    signal_cluster,
    cluster_n_otus_template,
    method,
    way
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = mean(false_reject, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 5. Combine all three ways: long table
## =========================================================

type1_table_long <- bind_rows(
  type1_abund_sum,
  type1_abund_sum_x_mean_abund,
  type1_max_n_otu_cluster
) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    method_label = unname(method_labels[as.character(method)]),
    way = factor(
      way,
      levels = c(
        "abund_sum",
        "abund_sum_x_mean_abund",
        "max_n_otu_cluster"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(way, across(all_of(situation_cols)), method)

## round only for display/table export
type1_table_long_round <- type1_table_long %>%
  mutate(
    type1_error = round(type1_error, 4),
    total_weight = ifelse(
      "total_weight" %in% names(.),
      round(total_weight, 4),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

write.csv(
  type1_table_long_round,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_long.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nLong-format type I error table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_long.csv"), "\n\n")

## =========================================================
## 6. Wide table: methods as columns
## =========================================================

type1_table_wide <- type1_table_long %>%
  select(
    all_of(situation_cols),
    way,
    method_label,
    type1_error
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type1_error = round(type1_error, 4)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method_label,
    values_from = type1_error
  ) %>%
  arrange(way, across(all_of(situation_cols)))

write.csv(
  type1_table_wide,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_wide.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Wide-format type I error table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_wide.csv"), "\n\n")

cat("============================================================\n")
cat("TYPE I ERROR TABLE UNDER EACH SITUATION\n")
cat("Wide format: one row = one situation and one way\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

print(as.data.frame(type1_table_wide), row.names = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## 7. Save one wide table per way
## =========================================================

for (ww in unique(as.character(type1_table_wide$way))) {
  
  tmp <- type1_table_wide %>%
    filter(way == ww) %>%
    select(-way)
  
  write.csv(
    tmp,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("type1_error_each_situation_", ww, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\nIndividual wide tables saved:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_abund_sum.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_abund_sum_x_mean_abund.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_max_n_otu_cluster.csv"), "\n")
```
